exposure: Intra-operative cell salvage (IOCS) during cesarean section
Allogeneic blood transfusion (ABT) during cesarean section
cohort: 361 patients diagnosed with central placenta previa who underwent cesarean section from May 2016 to December 2018
finding: Intra-operative cell salvage (IOCS) during cesarean delivery was associated with shorter postoperative hospital stay and higher postoperative hemoglobin levels compared to allogeneic blood transfusion.
